results.question: Does he use server-side rendering?
results.answer: Yes. He uses server-side rendering for pages that need fresh data on every request, and he chooses it alongside static generation, incremental static regeneration and client-side rendering depending on each page. He also builds server-rendered HTML so search engines can read the pages.
